lines.zh: 我一路小跑，脚尖几乎不落地。
lines.en: I jog along, toes barely touching down.

lines.zh: 装甲的接缝在响，吵得很。
lines.en: The armor seams rattle. Too loud.
I follow the patrol line east.

lines.zh: 草叶被我的气流压弯了。
lines.en: My wake bends the grass blades over.

lines.zh: 我把手搭在炮柄上走着。
lines.en: I walk with my hand on the blaster grip.
Gravel hops by my feet. I do not slow.

lines.zh: 前面是圣地，边界就在那。
lines.en: The holy land lies ahead; the border is there.

lines.zh: 我一步一步数着，走到一百。
lines.en: I count my steps up to a hundred.

lines.zh: 风把我的气拉成一条线。
lines.en: The wind draws my aura into a line.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，贴着地面滑行。
lines.en: I keep low and skim along the ground.

lines.zh: 路过一片焦土，是打过仗的。
lines.en: I pass scorched earth. A fight happened here.

lines.zh: 我换了个方向，朝高地走。
lines.en: I change direction for the high ground.
I stand in the grass without moving.

lines.zh: 风把护目镜上的灰吹不掉。
lines.en: The wind will not clear the dust off my visor.

lines.zh: 我一直在等命令，还没有。
lines.en: I keep waiting for orders. None yet.

lines.zh: 手心里的气慢慢聚起来，又散。
lines.en: Ki gathers in my palm, then fades.

lines.zh: 我把炮的弹匣拍了两下。
lines.en: I tap the blaster's magazine twice.

lines.zh: 远处一片云，走得比我慢。
lines.en: A cloud far off moves slower than I do.

lines.zh: 我把脚尖点在石头上，平衡住。
lines.en: I set my toe on a stone and hold balance.
Two days in this armor and it itches.
I open my mouth; the wind is dry.
I hold this line by myself.

lines.zh: 我抬头看太阳，算着时辰。
lines.en: I check the sun for the hour.
Insects in the grass. Very noisy.
I wipe the dust from my bracer.
The plain is too wide. Tiring to watch.
Slow down. Do not be in a hurry.

lines.zh: 你挡在我巡逻的路上了。
lines.en: You are standing in my patrol path.
Put your hands down. I cannot see them.

lines.zh: 你这身打扮，不像是本地人。
lines.en: You do not dress like a local.
What are you doing in this area?
You look like you can fight.
Alone? I doubt that.
Three counts, then the truth.

lines.zh: 你的手一直没离开刀鞘。
lines.en: Your hand never leaves that scabbard.
Do not reach behind your back.
I dislike being sized up.
This line is my post.
What were you looking at just now?
Walk back. Get behind me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子磨损得厉害，走了很远。
lines.en: Your boots are worn. You have come far.

lines.zh: 如果我说错了，你可以纠正。
lines.en: If I am wrong, correct me.

lines.zh: 我抬手，是让你停下的意思。
lines.en: My raised hand means stop.

lines.zh: 你腰上那把刀，抽出来看看。
lines.en: Draw that blade at your belt. Show me.
I turn and take only half the force.
My shoulder has gone numb.
My blaster is faster than my fist.
A fleck of blood on my visor.
That cost me half a step.
I hold my ki and steady myself.
An armor clasp has burst open.
It hurts, but the line holds.
I have his technique now.
I got careless, my ki was not full.
Whoever is cooking, hold still.

lines.zh: 这味道飘得满平原都是。
lines.en: That smell spreads across the whole plain.

lines.zh: 我盯着那口锅，忘了巡逻。
lines.en: I stare at the pot and forget the patrol.
Save me one hot bite.
One taste and it beats standard issue.

lines.zh: 我的胃又响了，真难为情。
lines.en: My stomach again. This is awkward.

lines.zh: 巡逻队不该停下来吃东西。
lines.en: A patrol should not stop to eat.
Right now I want to sit and eat.
Leave me the broth at the bottom of the pot.

lines.zh: 我把最后一块塞进嘴里。
lines.en: I push the last piece into my mouth.
You are in the way. Move.
You bump me. Will you pay for that?
My blaster nearly left my hand.
I will not hold that bump against you.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我要转身了。
lines.en: Not so close. I am turning.

lines.zh: 阿吉萨平原上，我的盔甲很亮。
lines.en: My armor shines on Ajisa Plains.
I push forward and so do you.
One step back. I count to one.
Let us both stay upright.

lines.zh: 你的肩甲撞在我的护腕上。
lines.en: Your pauldron rang off my bracer.
Not while on patrol.

lines.zh: 军营里没人管，也没人在意。
lines.en: Nobody in the barracks minds. Nobody cares either.

lines.zh: 她的编号我背得比自己的熟。
lines.en: I know her number better than my own.

lines.zh: 我们轮班的时候会多说两句。
lines.en: At shift change we talk a little more.

lines.zh: 她给我补过护腕的带子。
lines.en: She mended my bracer strap once.

lines.zh: 我把她的名字写在地上，又擦掉。
lines.en: I write her name in the dirt and wipe it out.
The sweet from the supply drop is for her.

lines.zh: 如果我们被调开，就这样吧。
lines.en: If we are reassigned, that is that.

lines.zh: 她从不说以后，我也不说。
lines.en: She never says later. Neither do I.

lines.zh: 换岗那一会儿，我们并肩站着。
lines.en: For that change of watch we stand side by side.
The iron ingot dropped. I pick it up.
This barrel section can still be repaired.

lines.zh: 我把地上的弹壳扫进袋子。
lines.en: I sweep the spent casings into a bag.
That broken plate is mine.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块有棱的石头。
lines.en: I pick up a stone with a good edge.
Something shines in the grass.

lines.zh: 我拾起一条断了的带子。
lines.en: I pick up a snapped strap.
This nail can patch armor.
I log the find, as required.

lines.zh: 手伸下去，我留了个心眼。
lines.en: I reach down, keeping my guard up.

lines.zh: 有人从草丛里站了起来。
lines.en: Someone just rose out of the grass.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经扣在扳机上。
lines.en: My finger is already on the trigger.
He runs well. Interesting.
I close in and give him no room.
That one. That back.

lines.zh: 我抬手，示意同伴别插手。
lines.en: I raise a hand: my squadmate stays out.

lines.zh: 他自己撞进我的视线里。
lines.en: He walked right into my view.
This will do for the report.
I know that armor. Enemy.
I let out a short laugh and he hears it.
He stopped. Even better.
Target locked. Pursuit begins.

lines.zh: 我不会给他第二次机会。
lines.en: He gets no second chance.
He runs for the trees. There is no way out there.
I bring my ki up into my chest.

lines.zh: 他手里的东西我感兴趣。
lines.en: I am interested in what he is holding.
He keeps running and I keep following.
No rush to strike. Let him tire.
He rounds a wall of rock.
My boots graze the grass tips.
He is waiting for something. So am I.
He gives one step; I take two.
This circling has gone on a while.
My eyes are on the small of his back.
He looks back and I freeze.
The gap closes to ten paces.

lines.zh: 他在找我的位置，找不到。
lines.en: He cannot find where I am.
I pull my aura in very small.
He is winded worse than I am.
I follow his footprints the whole way.
He stops and leans on a tree.
Two more steps and we are close enough.

lines.zh: 他手里那把刀抬起来了。
lines.en: That blade of his is coming up.
I wait for him to spend his strength.
My fist hammers the back of his neck.
At this range a fist is faster than a blaster.
I grab his shoulder and drag him down.
My knee drives into his belly.
He swings; I slip inside the arc.
The punch misses; the elbow follows.
I slam him into a tree trunk.
The blast bursts point blank and staggers him too.
I kick his shin and he drops to a knee.
I press his head down.
His blade grazes my ribs.
This kick sends him flying.
I catch his wrist and twist.

lines.zh: 拳头落在同一个位置两次。
lines.en: Two punches land in the same spot.
He lies in the grass, still moving.
I pin him underfoot until he stops.

lines.zh: 我从坡上下来，落在草里。
lines.en: I come down the slope into the grass.

lines.zh: 这次任务，只有我一个人。
lines.en: This task is mine alone.
Boots land and raise a small ring of dust.

lines.zh: 我把护目镜调亮了一档。
lines.en: I turn the visor up one notch.
There is one more of me on this plain.

lines.zh: 我降在石头上，先看四野。
lines.en: I set down on a rock and scan all sides.
The horizon is far too quiet.

lines.zh: 我的气把草丛压出一道沟。
lines.en: My aura presses a groove through the grass.
Report the number on landing. Regulation.

lines.zh: 我脚下这块石头有点松。
lines.en: This stone under my boot is loose.
I straighten and level the blaster.
The wind comes from the holy land.

lines.zh: 我落在地上的影子拉得很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long where I land.
I walk this line today.
This drop point is conspicuous. Never mind.

lines.zh: 我踩了踩地面，判断硬度。
lines.en: I test the ground with my foot.

lines.zh: 我把护腕转到外侧，刀刃朝上。
lines.en: I rotate my bracer outward, edge up.

lines.zh: 这片平原，我先丈量一遍。
lines.en: I will measure this plain before anything else.

lines.zh: 火从底下烧上来，我跳开。
lines.en: Fire came up from below and I leapt clear.

lines.zh: 我在空中断了气，直往下坠。
lines.en: My ki failed midair and I dropped.

lines.zh: 水把我按下去，气堵在胸口。
lines.en: Water pins me down and my ki jams in my chest.
The blast threw me a long way back.
An arrow sank into the seam of my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那股光钻进我的骨头里。
lines.en: That light has seeped into my bones.
Too long unfed; I cannot raise my ki.

lines.zh: 电光打在我背上，我一哆嗦。
lines.en: The bolt hit my back and I jerked.

lines.zh: 我被拖进一片空无一物的地方。
lines.en: I am dragged into a place with nothing in it.
